auth.login_description: Sign in to the system quickly and securely with your Lark account.
auth.lark_env_hint: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_LARK_APP_ID to .env.local and restart npm run dev.
auth.callback_description: We are verifying your Lark account. Please wait a moment.
auth.callback_received_result: Received the response from Lark. The next step is exchanging the code for an access token on the backend.
auth.callback_success_result: Your account has been verified. We will take you to the dashboard.
auth.callback_failed_result: We could not complete sign-in. Please check the server configuration and try again.
auth.callback_waiting_result: Waiting for the response from Lark.
auth.callback_missing_code: Did not receive a login code from Lark.
auth.callback_api_error: The server could not process the Lark callback yet.
